subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Should `attach --print-config` continue emitting the live token by default with a prominent stderr warning, or should this PR pause for a safe-by-default output redesign?
rationale: The warning is backwards-compatible and reduces accidental disclosure, but it deliberately preserves raw bearer-token output; choosing that permanent credential-handling boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept warning-only policy
options.body: Approve the compatible stderr warning after redacted live terminal proof, while tracking any optional log-safe mode separately.

options.title: Require safe output first
options.body: Pause this PR and redesign the default or add an explicit redacted summary mode before accepting the credential-output behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept warning-only policy
recommendation.body: Approve the compatible stderr warning after redacted live terminal proof, while tracking any optional log-safe mode separately.
